name: handspace-ai
description: HandSpace AI - AI-powered hand gesture control for 3D space interaction

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')) { fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true}); console.log('✅ Cleaned dist folder'); } else { console.log('ℹ️  dist folder does not exist'); }"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const distFiles=fs.readdirSync('dist'); distFiles.forEach(f=>{fs.copyFileSync(path.join('dist',f),f);}); console.log('✅ Copied dist files to root for deployment');"
